name: Temporary Residence Permit -- Family Relations

requirements.blocker_text: Close family ties to an Azerbaijani citizen (e.g. spouse, child, parent), evidenced by notarized birth certificates, marriage certificates, and identification documents proving the relationship.
A notarized consent application from the sponsoring family member is required.

evidence_required.document: Notarized birth certificate or marriage certificate
Notarized consent application from the sponsoring family member

sources.title: Azerbaijan State Migration Service -- grounds for temporary residence permit via family relations to an Azerbaijani citizen: notarized birth/marriage certificates and family member's notarized consent

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Azerbaijan). No sponsor income or housing-adequacy threshold was found described on the tier-1 page reviewed -- disclosed as a gap rather than invented. IMPORTANT: unlike most other countries built in this dataset (Armenia, Morocco, Oman, Serbia), marriage to an Azerbaijani citizen does NOT itself confer or fast-track citizenship in Azerbaijan -- Article 7 of the Law on Citizenship explicitly states that marriage or divorce involving an Azerbaijani citizen 'shall not be a reason for change of citizenship', and no marriage-based reduced naturalisation track was found (see az_naturalisation.json's notes). citizenship_after_months (60) therefore reuses the ordinary 5-year naturalisation figure rather than a marriage-specific shortcut, and this route leads only to residence status, not an accelerated citizenship path.
